title: Triple Riding
desc: A man falls in love with the daughter of a rich business. However, his life turns into chaos when he pretends to be a doctor to help her friend escape an arranged marriage.

title: Chamak
desc: Kush reluctantly marries Khushi. However, things take a drastic turn when they both start getting to know each other and uncover the lies they fed one another.

title: Varsha
desc: After his mother's death and father's arrest, Sathya brings up his seven sisters like a father. But a villainous character from his father's past turns the siblings against each other.

title: Namma Basava
desc: A bountiful and helpful boy falls in love with a musician without knowing the fact that a rich spoilt brat is also planning to woo her.
